sources: Typical adult isokinetic/isometric joint torque magnitudes per kg body mass, approximate start value, not verified against the original (order of published dynamometry ranges; no specific source verified).
note: Nm per kg body mass. "+" and "-" follow the pose-axis sign in joints.json (flex +: flexion; abd +: abduction; rot +: internal; elbow pron +: pronation; wrist flex +: flexion, dev +: radial; ankle flex +: dorsiflexion, inv +: inversion; hip rot and spine/neck/head side, twist, turn: sign set by jointRotation, values symmetric). hadd is engine-only: + horizontal adduction, - abduction. pelvis and scapula joints are excluded (root and derived).
